data.title: Artesian Resources reports Q2 2026: revenue $30.7M, diluted EPS $0.64, YTD revenue $58.4M
data.description:
Artesian Resources reported second-quarter 2026 net income of $6.6 million and diluted earnings per share of $0.64, up from $0.61 a year earlier. Revenue for the quarter rose to $30.7 million, a 7.4% increase year-over-year, and year-to-date revenue reached $58.4 million with diluted EPS of $1.21 for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Management cited temporary Delaware rate increases, customer growth and continued capital investment in water and wastewater infrastructure as key drivers.

Financial Highlights

  • Quarterly revenue: $30.7 million for Q2 2026, up $2.1 million (7.4%) versus Q2 2025.
  • Year-to-date revenue: $58.4 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026, up $4.0 million (7.4%) year-over-year.
  • Net income: $6.6 million for Q2 2026, a $0.3 million (4.5%) increase versus Q2 2025.
  • Year-to-date net income: $12.5 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026, a $0.8 million (6.7%) increase versus prior year.
  • Diluted earnings per share: $0.64 for Q2 2026 (up 4.9% year-over-year); $1.21 for YTD 2026 (up 6.1% year-over-year).

Business Highlights

  • Water sales growth driven by temporary rate increases permitted under Delaware law (pending DEPSC permanent rates) and an increase in customer counts.
  • Other utility revenue rose notably from industrial wastewater treatment services and additional residential and commercial wastewater customers.
  • Non-utility revenue growth tied to Service Line Protection Plan (SLP Plan) fee increases effective January 1, 2026 and higher participant enrollment.
  • Operating expenses (excluding depreciation and income taxes) rose, led by higher payroll and employee benefit costs, supply and treatment costs, and increased plumbing repair costs associated with SLP Plans.
  • Capital expenditures of $25.9 million in the first half of 2026 focused on mains, services and hydrants, infrastructure renewals, meter upgrades, wastewater force mains, pump/treatment station upgrades (including PFAS treatment), and new wastewater treatment plants to support service expansion and regulatory compliance.

Original SEC Filing: ARTESIAN RESOURCES CORP [ ARTNA ] - 8-K - Aug. 07, 2026

data.title: From Corporate Action to Community Impact: An Overview of Tandem Global's Social Impact Model and Its Application Across Programs and Partnerships
data.description:
New White Paper from Tandem Global, Sponsored by Koch

BETHESDA, MD / ACCESS Newswire / August 7, 2026 / Tandem Global announces the release of a new white paper, From Corporate Action to Community Impact: An Overview of Tandem Global's Social Impact Model and Its Application Across Programs and Partnerships, available for download today. This white paper is sponsored by Koch.

For much of modern business history, corporate success was measured primarily through financial performance and shareholder returns. This perspective has evolved as organizations increasingly recognize that long-term value creation depends on the health and resilience of the broader social and ecological systems in which they operate. As a result, businesses are increasingly viewed not only as economic actors but also as influential institutions shaping economic opportunity, community development, and social outcomes worldwide. This changing relationship between business and society has elevated the importance of social impact.

This white paper explores Tandem Global's Social Impact Model and how the organization empowers the private sector to create lasting value for people and communities. By examining consulting initiatives, WHC Certification®, and grant-funded projects, it demonstrates how collaboration between businesses and communities can create measurable environmental and social outcomes while building the partnerships needed for long-term resilience.

Featured case studies include:

  • Buzzi Unicem, Wildlife Habitat and Outdoor Classroom: Pryor, OK

  • General Motors, SGM Jinqiao: Shanghai, China

  • WM, Southeastern Microhabitat Initiatives: U.S.A.

Sponsored by Koch, this white paper features a foreword from Sheryl Corrigan, Vice President, Environmental, Health and Safety, offering insight into how corporate leadership and cross-sector collaboration can drive meaningful, measurable social impact and create lasting benefits for communities.

About Tandem Global

Tandem Global (formerly Wildlife Habitat Council and World Environment Center), provides the know-how and the network to move business and the environment forward, together. Across sectors and at all levels of its member organizations, Tandem Global works to facilitate long-term and lasting impact on all aspects of our natural world. It connects leading thinking with practical solutions that positively impact climate, nature, and water. From field operations to boardrooms and beyond, corporate leaders turn to Tandem Global for impact strategies and resilient solutions that can support a better future. Tandem Global is headquartered in Bethesda, MD, USA, with locations across the U.S., in Latin America and Munich, Germany. For more information visit tandemglobal.org.

Find more stories and multimedia from Tandem Global at 3blmedia.com.

data.title: REG - capAI PLC - Clarification Re: Admission of Ordinary Shares
data.description:
RNS Number : 8362P capAI PLC 07 August 2026  

7 August 2026

capAI plc

(the "Company" and, together with its subsidiaries and subsidiary undertakings, the "Group" or "capAI")

Clarification Regarding Admission of Ordinary Shares

capAI plc (LSE: CPAI, OTCQB: CPIQF) (the "Company") refers to its announcements dated 7 May 2026 regarding the exercise of warrants and 5 August 2026 regarding the Company's £280,000 fundraise (the "Fundraise").

Following a review of the Company's admission arrangements, it was noted that the admission to trading of the 5,290,000 Ordinary Shares issued pursuant to the exercise of warrants announced on 7 May 2026 (the "Warrant Shares") had not been completed at that time.

The Company has therefore included the Warrant Shares within its current application for admission to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange alongside the shares issued pursuant to the Fundraise.

Accordingly, a total of 70,178,887 Ordinary Shares of £0.0001 each (the "Admission Shares") will be admitted to trading, with admission expected to become effective and dealings expected to commence at 8.00 a.m. on 10 August 2026, comprising:

·      62,222,221 new Ordinary Shares issued pursuant to the Fundraise;

·      2,666,666 new Ordinary Shares* issued to advisers in connection with the Fundraise; and

·      5,290,000 Ordinary Shares previously issued following the exercise of warrants.

For the avoidance of doubt, the Warrant Shares were issued on 7 May 2026 and do not represent a further issue of shares or any additional fundraising proceeds.

Following admission of the Admission Shares, the Company's issued share capital will comprise 491,321,950 Ordinary Shares. The Company does not hold any shares in treasury and, accordingly, the total number of voting rights in the Company will be 491,321,950.

All other details contained in the Company's announcement dated 5 August 2026 remain unchanged.
